flora: Ponga Crozier (tightly coiled fiddlehead covered in brown fuzzy scales)
Silver Frond (close-up showing the forest-green top and striking silver-white underside)
Ponga sapling (small trunkless cluster of arching fronds)
Trunk detail (fibrous, dark brown 'woody' texture made of old leaf bases)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; emphasis on the 'fuzzy' texture of the fiddleheads; high contrast between the green and silver of the leaves; clear quadrant separation.

visual_logic.composition: A quadrant tiled composition: Top-Left: A macro view of a fuzzy brown crozier; Top-Right: An overturned frond showing the silver underside; Bottom-Left: A young sapling; Bottom-Right: A high-detail view of the fibrous, textured trunk.
visual_logic.ground: Damp red-brown earth with a light scattering of ochre silt.
visual_logic.lighting: Clear, even, bright diffused daylight to emphasize the metallic silver sheen on the leaf undersides.
